message.content: The pain in my upper back, between my shoulder blades, started about two days ago. It stays in one spot and doesn't travel anywhere. After that, my legs got weaker and weaker until I couldn't stand up. Now I've lost control of my bladder and bowels, and I can't feel much around my groin and bottom area. No fever, no injury or heavy lifting, and no recent vaccines. I don't have any health problems, I'm not on blood thinners, and I don't take any other medications.
